info.title: Soroticket Testnet Cloud API
info.description: Tranche 1 baseline. Testnet only; TEST and METERED never move mainnet value. The console uses the same-origin /api prefix. API key auth or an HttpOnly session is accepted on /v1. Browser session mutations require same origin. Publish no PII in campaign names/codes. Off-chain receipts attest events, not physical truth.
